items: Traditional dashboards make multi-location operators dig through charts and guess at root causes, so teams spend more time managing data than improving the experience.
Generative Customer Intelligence (GenCI) analyzes reviews, surveys and store reports for you, flags what is urgent and recommends next steps.
What your teams need are plain answers, such as which stores need coaching this week and the most common cause behind low ratings.
Sticking with dashboards alone tends to mean missed trends, slow reactions to feedback and frontline teams unsure of what to focus on.
